definition: προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,  [in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;] __1. to foresee.  __2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rom.12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co.8:21 (-οῦμεν).  __3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Ti.5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).† (AS)
